answer: PoA’s trust trellis combines EigenTrust-style centrality with reciprocity-weighted transitivity, so influence follows corroborated service rather than identity count. A gale of freshly spawned Sybil identities begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted reciprocal links, they cannot climb the ledge into consensus influence.
